name: hakim
description: Use ChatGPT as the conversational brain and Hakim as a permission-gated Android execution arm.

interface.longDescription: Hakim lets ChatGPT inspect an authorized Android device and request carefully permission-gated actions. Read operations include device status, UI state, authorized notifications, and screenshots. State-changing actions remain subject to Hakim and Android approval gates.
defaultPrompt: Check the state of my authorized Android device with Hakim.
Inspect what is currently visible on my authorized Android device.
Open an app on my authorized Android device, asking for approval when required.
